subject.title: Add multi-gateway cron job coordination for HA deployments

question: Should distributed cron ownership be implemented as a core Gateway feature, a plugin-provided coordination API, or a cron-specific requirement under the broader horizontal-scaling/runtime design?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but backend boundary, config shape, failure semantics, health/CLI visibility, dependency policy, and relation to broader HA architecture require maintainer product and architecture intent.

options.title: Design Backend-Neutral Ownership
options.body: Define a generic cron lease or leader contract before adding Redis, etcd, DynamoDB, SQLite, or plugin-backed implementations.

options.title: Fold Into Broader HA Design
options.body: Make this issue a cron-specific requirement of the horizontal-scaling or distributed-runtime trackers and close it only after that design explicitly owns cron scheduling.

options.title: Document External-Only Operation
options.body: Keep built-in cron single-Gateway for now and document an external scheduler or external lock pattern as the supported HA path.

recommendation.title: Design Backend-Neutral Ownership
recommendation.body: Define a generic cron lease or leader contract before adding Redis, etcd, DynamoDB, SQLite, or plugin-backed implementations.

likelyOwner.reason: This account already provided architecture-review guidance on the live issue and is tied to the process-local cron duplicate guard history.
